title: Eternal Wish — 24cm Dragon & Hero Display Figure
descriptionHtml:
Some legends don’t enter the room quietly.

Coiled through storm clouds with a young hero riding at its center, this finished display figure turns one of anime’s most unforgettable wish-making moments into a shelf-sized centerpiece. The looping dragon silhouette brings movement from every angle, while the cloud-and-rock base gives the whole scene the presence it deserves.

It’s bold without feeling like clutter. Familiar without needing an introduction. Built for the shelf that still remembers the wish.

⚡ Display Details:

  • Approximately 9.4 in (24 cm) tall
  • Painted PVC construction
  • Dynamic coiled-dragon sculpture with a cloud-and-rock display base
  • Includes a young hero riding a translucent golden cloud
  • Finished display model
  • Approximately 1:12 scale, according to the supplier
  • Collector-box packaging

Big silhouette. Familiar energy. Zero need for an introduction.

Display collectible. Small parts may be present; not intended for young children. Because each piece is finished individually, minor differences in paint, color, and measurements may occur.
